__comment: EXAMPLE/DEV rules (vanilla-only, so they work in the standalone run). The first is a FAMILY rule: oak_planks -> spruce_planks automatically cascades the oak->spruce material swap to oak_stairs/slab/fence/fence_gate/door/log/stripped_oak_log/etc. -> spruce_* wherever the target block exists. The second is exact - 'cobblestone' and 'mossy_cobblestone' differ by more than one path token, so no cascade is derived. Use "family": false on a from/to rule to force exact-only. NOTE: a published library normally ships NO active rules (these would rewrite everyone's blueprints); delete this file for a clean library, and let consumers supply rules under data/<their_namespace>/block_substitutions/.
